summary.intent: Wire CTR encryption mode into the SDK's uploadFile() so large media files use streaming-friendly AES-CTR instead of hardcoded GCM, then get a PR up and resolve review comments.
summary.outcome: CTR encryption is now correctly selected for large media files (>256KB, streaming MIME types) through the full SDK upload path. MIME type logic was centralized into sdk-core/encryption-mode.ts, all PR review comments were resolved, and all mock-based SDK tests were fixed to survive new exports.

repo: selectEncryptionMode() existed only in the web app's streaming-crypto.service.ts and was never called for new SDK uploads — only for the duplicate-file re-encrypt path.

The STREAMING_MIME_TYPES set and CTR_SIZE_THRESHOLD (256KB) were duplicated between sdk/client.ts and apps/web/src/services/streaming-crypto.service.ts — now centralized in sdk-core/encryption-mode.ts.
audio/flac was missing from STREAMING_MIME_TYPES in both locations.
The web app's selectEncryptionMode takes a File object (browser API), while the centralized version takes (mimeType, size) — the web app now has a thin wrapper.
The SDK type system depends on sdk-core build output — typecheck on sdk will fail with stale sdk-core artifacts until sdk-core is rebuilt.
integration.test.ts in packages/sdk hits a real API endpoint and has pre-existing failures unrelated to local changes.
The PR targets fix/e2e-test-failures-v2, not main — will need retargeting after that branch merges.

code.finding: uploadFile() hardcoded encryptAesGcm and 'GCM' mode — now accepts optional encryptionMode param and dispatches to encryptAesCtr + generateCtrIv when 'CTR'.
New module centralizing STREAMING_MIME_TYPES set, CTR_SIZE_THRESHOLD (256KB), selectEncryptionMode(mimeType, size), and normalizeEncryptionMode() coercion helper.
uploadFile() now calls selectEncryptionMode(file.type, file.size) imported from sdk-core before delegating to sdkCore.uploadFile().
Local selectEncryptionMode(file: File) replaced with thin wrapper delegating to sdk-core's selectEncryptionMode(file.type, file.size).
Removed test.skip from CTR encrypted badge test — now passes (319ms).
vi.mock('@cipherbox/sdk-core') with explicit factory object breaks when new exports are added — fixed by spreading importActual.
Pre-existing: PublishIpnsResponseDto no longer has cid field; ResolveIpnsResponseDto no longer has source field — mocks were stale.
Pre-existing: addToIpfs mock returned {cid} but IpfsAddResult type requires {cid, size, recorded}.

workflow: SDK test mocks using explicit vi.mock factory objects (not importActual) are fragile — any new export added to sdk-core breaks all SDK tests that mock it.
Rebuilding sdk-core before typechecking sdk is required when sdk-core's public API changes.
E2E streaming tests ran successfully against local dev servers without any HMR/rebuild issues after rebuilding packages.
GSD todo workflow correctly tracked the todo through pending → done and committed the move.

friction: sdk typecheck failed after initial implementation because sdk-core build output was stale — required an explicit rebuild step.
Five SDK test files all had the same fragile vi.mock pattern that broke on the new selectEncryptionMode export — had to fix them individually.
Push was blocked by a remote divergence requiring stash/rebase/pop before the PR review comment fixes could be pushed.
CI caught the missing mock export that local tests didn't surface because local test run excluded the concurrency test file.
open_items: PR #399 targets fix/e2e-test-failures-v2, not main — needs retargeting or will auto-update when the parent branch merges.
integration.test.ts in packages/sdk has pre-existing failures hitting a real API endpoint — not addressed.

The streaming-crypto.service.ts selectEncryptionMode wrapper and the sdk-core version have slightly different signatures (File vs mimeType+size) — could be unified further if the web app is ever refactored.
BYO-IPFS register-cid 400 errors on staging (todo #13) still pending.
